scripts.build: npm --prefix fe run build && npm run bundle:be
scripts.bundle:be: rm -rf src-tauri/resources/be && mkdir -p src-tauri/resources/be && cp -r be/dist src-tauri/resources/be/dist && cp be/package.json src-tauri/resources/be/package.json && cd src-tauri/resources/be && npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n be,fe -c blue,green "npm run dev:be" "npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix fe install && npm --prefix be install && npm --prefix be run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules fe/node_modules be/node_modules be/dist src-tauri/target
